title: M5.2: SMS verification spike: End User Messaging versus Twilio
description:
Verify and record: current End User Messaging SMS two-way flow (inbound to SNS, event destinations, opt-out list behavior, keyword handling), CloudFormation coverage for opt-out list, configuration set, pool and phone number, sandbox limits, segment pricing, number rent and any registration fees; compare Twilio on setup time, webhook signature, cost and secrets; confirm Amazon Connect is out. Output: decision comment and corrections to contract section 10.2.

Acceptance criteria:
- Table of verified prices and lead times
- Go decision on one provider with a stated fallback

Gherkin: none (infrastructure or owner task); infra tests or a runbook are the evidence.

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).
